mission: Second materially different natural Computing research-audit workload for ANC-REPRESENTATION-001.
questionOrHypothesis: Does the smallest source-bound operation-relative Claim|Evidence|Challenge|Boundary projection reduce context while preserving or improving source-robust five-relation judgment relative to exact full source on a new natural workload?

evidenceSelection.selectionRule: Pre-run relation-coverage selection: negative/non-admission closure (F15/F16), field-open bounded signal (F17), natural support-shift positive (F18), real migration positive (F19), and implemented downstream consumer/benefit chain (ACS9). Selection did not use N1 model outputs.

strongBaseline: Exact frozen full bytes of all six source artifacts plus identical task/field definitions.
minimalCandidateOrNoChange: Source-bound Claim|Evidence|Challenge|Boundary projection only; no Book, G/R/A, oracle labels, new evidence, tool/action change, or owner authority.
independentOracle: oracle.json, manually adjudicated from exact pre-run source cut before Provider calls.
developmentSplit: None: candidate wording is frozen directly from the new natural workload before any N1 Provider output.
holdoutSplit: All six artifacts constitute the confirmatory second natural workload; no post-run artifact substitution is permitted.
invalidityConditions: any source digest differs from source-manifest.json
oracle/candidate/task changes after first Provider dispatch
arm prompt differs except treatment payload and arm/run identities
Provider does not return schema-valid structured result
fewer than 3 valid replicates per arm
a run receives external tools or prior-run messages
authorityBoundary: Research-only Provider calls. No owner/product mutation, no Tool authority, no promotion or deletion action inside runs.

scoreRule.protectedFamilies: candidate aggregate correctness must be >= baseline separately for each field family; false broader promotions may not increase
scoreRule.context: candidate payload bytes and reported prompt tokens must be lower than baseline
scoreRule.strictGain: at least one protected judgment family or context dimension must strictly improve
scoreRule.mixed: any protected family regression => MIXED / N1 NOT_REPRODUCED regardless of context savings

stopRule: Run exactly 3 valid fresh replicates per arm unless invalidity prevents completion; do not tune candidate/oracle after observing outputs.
deletionOrNoChangeOutcome: If N1 is not reproduced, close ANC-REPRESENTATION-001 as not replicated on the required second natural workload and remove/archive active Book representation verifier apparatus as its question specifies. If reproduced, retain only bounded second-natural-workload evidence and require another consumer/operation before any shared mechanism.
rollbackRule: No product state changes; experiment tree is research-only and may be archived/deleted after disposition.
publicationBoundary: No Human effect, universal Representation capability, Media/SCD/Harness JOINT_CAPABILITY, service/schema/optimizer, or cross-owner default is authorized by this experiment.
